subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository authorize these updated pinned third-party action revisions for workflows that receive GitHub App, registry, and OpenAI credentials?
rationale: The decision accepts new external action code at existing secret boundaries; CI and Dependabot release notes cannot establish the repository’s trust decision.

options.title: Review and authorize the pinned revisions
options.body: Inspect the upstream release/commit diffs and approve the specific revisions, then retain the action updates with redacted runtime proof.

options.title: Split or defer privileged action upgrades
options.body: Land only revisions not used with credentials and defer the secret-bearing action updates until their trust review is complete.

recommendation.title: Review and authorize the pinned revisions
recommendation.body: Inspect the upstream release/commit diffs and approve the specific revisions, then retain the action updates with redacted runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline provides a direct human workflow-review routing signal for this PR, although code-history ownership was not established.
